#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

const ll MOD = 1000000007;

bool visited[1000000];
ll K_val, P_val;

void traverse(ll node) {
    if (visited[node]) return;
    visited[node] = true;
    traverse((node * K_val) % P_val);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%lld %lld", &P_val, &K_val);
    
    ll result = 1;
    
    if (K_val == 1) {
        result = (result * P_val) % MOD;
    }
    
    for (ll idx = 1; idx < P_val; ++idx) {
        if (!visited[idx]) {
            traverse(idx);
            result = (result * P_val) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    printf("%lld\n", result);
    
    return 0;
}
